about.description: A tree-sitter parser for YAML files.

build.script:
${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv

if [ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  for _f in "${PREFIX}"/lib/python*/site-packages/${{ name | replace("-", "_") }}/_binding.abi3-*.so; do
    [ -e "${_f}" ] || continue
    _want="$(dirname "${_f}")/_binding.abi3.so"
    echo "cross-build: renaming $(basename "${_f}") -> $(basename "${_want}")"
    mv -f "${_f}" "${_want}"
  done
fi

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: tree-sitter-yaml
  version: "0.7.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: aeaff5731bb8b66c7054c8aed33cd5edea5f4cd2ac71654f3f6c2ba2073d8fac

build:
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - |
          ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv
          
          if [ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-0}" = "1" ]; then
            for _f in "${PREFIX}"/lib/python*/site-packages/${{ name | replace("-", "_") }}/_binding.abi3-*.so; do
              [ -e "${_f}" ] || continue
              _want="$(dirname "${_f}")/_binding.abi3.so"
              echo "cross-build: renaming $(basename "${_f}") -> $(basename "${_want}")"
              mv -f "${_f}" "${_want}"
            done
          fi
    - if: win
      then:
        - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-build-isolation -vv
  number: 3


requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - if: target_platform != build_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - python
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools >=42
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - tree_sitter_yaml
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -m pytest bindings/python/tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - python
        - tree_sitter >=0.22
    files:
      source:
        - bindings/python/tests/

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml
  summary: 'YAML grammar for tree-sitter.'
  description: |
    A tree-sitter parser for YAML files.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  repository: https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-yaml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MementoRC
